lines.en: I walk into the room with Chika (Who immediately ducks into the bathroom to fix her makeup) and find that the rest of the girls have already started handing out presents.
I’m assuming there’s no way I’m actually exempt from giving someone a gift, so I guess this is the moment of truth where I just wait around to see who I disappoint.
Unless I actually do wind up with Chika.
In that case, I’ll just use her first semi-public orgasm as my Secret Santa present.
Which would be kind of awesome because I didn’t even have to giftwrap it.
: What is with that face?
: What face? What are you talking about?
: You have a disgusting expression that makes it look like you’re reflecting on something gross you’ve probably done.
: I think...you look the same as always...Sensei...
: Yes, I agree.
: You always look like you’re caught in the middle of thinking something horrible.
: That...isn’t what I said.
: Thank you for being so pure, Sana.
: And thank you Maya for...
: For what?
: For always wearing clothes that accentuate your legs.
: You had me for Secret Santa, didn’t you?
: I’d have given you something much different if that were true.
: Oh yeah? And what would-
: Anthrax.
: ...Okay, so moving right along then. Shouldn’t you two be giving your gifts out instead of just standing around?
: Who did you have?
: I...had Chika but...she kind of disappeared into the bathroom so now I have to keep standing here awkwardly.
Shit. Looks like I will be disappointing someone after all.
: What did you get her?
: Well...I don’t really know her well so I...wound up just buying her some...girly stuff I found from the mall.
: Rin helped me, but she kept trying to make me go over the spending limit.
: She even offered using her own money, but...that just felt strange...
: Yeah that sounds about right.
: If there’s anyone who knows what Chika would like, it’s Rin.
: R-Really? Not Yumi?
: Nope. Definitely Rin.
: I didn’t realize they were that close...
: Sometimes I don’t think they’re close enough.
: I...don’t know what that means.
: Don’t worry. I’ll tell you when you’re older.
: What?
: And Maya? What about you?
: Who’s the lucky recipient of whatever strange gift you decided to purchase?
: Futaba. Also MIA.
: I think she went to get some water. Seeing everyone kiss seemed to really take a toll on her.
: Wait, don’t tell me that kept going after I left the room?
: You missed out on an entire orgy. Poor Sana nearly had to go to the hospital.
: Wha-?!
: Th-th-th-th-that never happened!
: I’ve still never...k...k...
: Good. Stay that way forever.
: For...ever?...
: Joking aside. All of the debauchery managed to miraculously end the second you left the room.
: I wonder how that happened?
Pretty sure Chika just brought all of it outside.
And that, I am thankful for.
: So...I guess since you two are the only ones standing around, it means one of you is the person I have to disappoint?
: Oh, you had me. I’ve known the whole time.
: But I’m used to you disappointing me, so it’s fine that you didn’t get me anything.
: Wait, you knew this whole time and you didn’t tell me?
: I specifically asked you earlier because I figured you’d know.
: Are you saying you lied to me back then?
: I lie to you literally all the time. I don’t think this should come as that big of a surprise.
: Why, though? Don’t you want a present?
: Not really.
: But if this is about not looking like a complete jerk, you can just tell everyone that this scarf was an early Secret Santa present.
: But then again, I don’t think you care much about not looking like a jerk, so you can just disregard that.
: I really want to feel bad about myself for letting you down right now but being insulted is making that a little more difficult.
: It’s fine. You hate Christmas anyway.
: Use my present money to get something for Ami or Ayane. You know- people who would actually like to receive presents from you.
: You liked the scarf so much that you literally collapsed.
: That never happened.
: I graciously accepted this accessory and politely bowed before walking away.
: The reset must have destroyed your memory.
: R...Reset?
: It’s a long story.
Did she really just summarize the fact that we’ve literally reset the[school] year together twice with “It’s a long story?”
I mean, she’s not wrong but...
That seems kind of anti-climactic.
: There’s really nothing I can do to make it up to you?
: To make it up to me? Hmm...
: Could you leave me alone forever?
: Nope.
: Didn’t think so.
: Then no.
: The best thing you could do right now, though, is stop drawing attention to the fact that the two of us are talking to one another.
: You’re an annoyingly popular character, so it will be quite troublesome if people begin to think I’m somehow close to you.
: Okay, but eventually I’m going to-
: Umm...
I feel a suspiciously light tapping on my shoulder after hearing Yumi interject.
And I say “suspiciously light” because I assume she is the one tapping me and I associate nothing but pent-up aggression with that girl.
: This is the part where you turn around.
I turn around to find a rather timid version of the class delinquent hiding half of her face behind a brightly colored notebook.
And judging by the fact that this particular notebook has “Not a gift” written on it in black permanent marker, I think it’s safe to assume that it is, actually, a gift.
: Yo.
: Is that for me?
: Not because I want it to be.
: I was just the last person to draw a name out of the stupid fucking hat and everyone probably threw your name back in because you suck so much.
: But you still got me something anyway?
: I figured you would have just skipped something like this.
: I wanted to but...Chika and Chinami found out and made me do this.
: It’s not like I bought anything or whatever, though. I just kind of...wrote you a note. I guess.
: Well, can I read it?
: No. Fuck off.
: So you wrote me a note that I’m not allowed to read and that is my Christmas present?
: You can read it just...
: My body won’t let me hand it over to you.
: Probably because it’s looking out for me and knows it will be a bad move if I show you anything that could even be confused for affection.
: Give me the hate letter, Yumi.
: I-It’s not a hate letter!
: It was going to be but the fuckin...Chosokabes kept makin’ me rewrite it until they approved it!
: So this is the fifth letter! Or sixth! I don’t even remember!
: AAAAAHHH JUST FUCKING TAKE IT!
Yumi gives up on hiding and literally throws the notebook at my chest.
I catch it with my impressively great reflexes and immediately retreat to the door to see what she could have possibly written about me.
This is actually weirdly touching.
Maybe it’s just the obnoxiously happy background music or the fact that she was so embarrassed about handing this over but...
I actually like this present a lot.
It’s the perfect thing for someone like me who hates the holidays and can’t find a point for most material goods.
Sometimes, it’s good to just...hear what someone has to say from the heart.
And sure this might be a little more exaggerated or kind than how Yumi really feels-
But the fact that she was able to write something like this down after what I did to her is really...
Rewarding?
Surprising, maybe?
Oh no. This isn’t one of those Christmas miracles, is it?
: Make fun of me and I’ll fucking kill you. Got it?
: Thanks, Yumi. I really appreciate this.
: You appreciate me calling you “Not the worst ever?”
: You know, I really do.
: Oh. Well...cool, I guess.
: Can you give me the notebook back now?
: Wait, you need it back?
: That’s the only notebook I own and I need it for[school].
: You don’t even come to[school].
: And I wouldn’t give you any notes to take even if you did.
: J-Just give it back, okay?! It’s embarrassing for you to hang on to it!
: I don’t want you fucking...jerking off on it or something.
: I can’t believe I have to say this but I’m not going to jerk off on your Christmas present.
: Like I’d fuckin’ believe that! Give it back, asshole!
Yumi moves toward me to try and grab the notebook forcefully, causing me to backpedal and make my way toward the door with a death grip on it.
This may seem like just a silly note to some, but for me- it is a symbol of progress.
A trophy that I must treasure.
I shall protect it in any way I can.
: Huh? What’s going on out here?
: FUCKING...STOP...RUNNING!
: I go into the bathroom for five minutes and that’s all it takes for you to explode? What happened?
: Chika! Tell him to give me back my notebook!
: Your notebook?
: Is this because of the Secret Santa thing?
: Yes! Tell him he has to give it back!
: But...he doesn’t.
: Do you not understand how presents work?
: He...gets to keep that?!
: Of course~
: Besides, doesn’t it make you happy knowing he can pull it out and look at it whenever he wants?
: Uhhhhhhh, no?!
: If he keeps that then...where am I going to write all of my notes for[school]?!
: You don’t even come to[school].
: And Sensei wouldn’t give you any notes to take even if you did.
: See? That’s exactly what I said.
: Stay the fuck out of this. This doesn’t concern you.
: This is literally about me...
Yumi and Chika proceed to argue about how imperative it is that Yumi gets her notebook back.
We offer the compromise for me to just remove the page with the note on it but, of course, this was never about not being able to take notes for[school].
I don’t know if Yumi’s afraid of looking weak or if she just thinks I’m going to...use this against her in some way-
But I really do just want to keep it and tuck it away in some drawer to forget about and probably look back on for nostalgic value many years from now.
If I even make it to “many years from now.”
But hey, months ago, I never would have even dreamed of getting an acknowledgement of how I’m not literally Satan from Yumi.
So if this can happen, literally anything can happen.
A loud bang can be heard from outside as the walls of the hotel are dyed with bright, red light.
In addition to Christmas lights and decorations, it seems like fireworks are a thing I’m apparently going to have to deal with now as well.
One by one, girls begin leaving the room and heading outside, grabbing my sleeves and trying to get me to come with them.
There are two exceptions to this.
Well, I guess three technically.
The first two come in the form of Makoto and Miku, who leave the room in a hurry- likely to get Miku somewhere she won’t be able to hear anything.
I think about following them, but realize Makoto is probably better suited to dealing with Miku’s condition than I’ll ever be.
Instead, I remain in the room with the second exception to the sudden and intense interest in fireworks.
